About

A reference site about documents sold on Telegram, built by a buyer rather than a seller.

Editorial position

No document on this site is described as genuine. Every page states the replica versus registered original distinction, because that distinction is the whole market. Prices are observed ranges from public adverts and are labelled as such.

What is not here

No stock list, no affiliate links, no seller ranking, no legal advice. Where the law matters, the page says so and stops.

Method

Each page is generated from one data file: the issuing office per document per country, an observed price band in local currency, two local checks and one local red flag. The generic checks come from the document type. Nothing is invented per page.

Corrections

Authorities reorganise and price bands drift. Corrections by email are welcome and are applied at the next build.

Contact

Corrections and price-band updates are welcome by email. Telegram handle is added shortly.
